Sampling methods: positions from track.py (template: hub label, sphere, far tile, corner hexagons, brand mark; bbox: top-left card, single hexagon); opacities that overlap other moving content were measured per frame with small scripts and written to scratch/ before fitting with fit_easing.py: headline opacity/offset by least-squares projection of the settled headline's darkness (scratch/c2_hl*.csv), card cross-dissolve on camera-stabilised card crops resampled with the measured camera (scratch/c2_t1_morph_bands.csv), team fades and morph timings by sampling each node along its measured zoom path (scratch/c2_t2_tile_fade_rows.csv, scratch/c2_t3_*.csv), packets by blob detection against the hold's temporal median (scratch/c2_s2_packets.csv).
